svg.title: R2DBC Caffeine Cache Flow
svg.desc: Sequence diagram showing read-through, write-through, write-behind, invalidation, and close behavior for the R2DBC Caffeine repository.
svg.text: AsyncCache serves local hits, misses load through suspendTransaction, and write-behind flushes batches from a coroutine worker.

g.text: Caffeine is local AsyncCache only; all DB access uses R2DBC suspendTransaction; write-behind close waits for final flush.
